findings.detail: Root criterion c-test-passes is not met by the designated verify-tests report (acc-9d8568a80654ae2eb763277d5621496e, port report). evidence_requirement requires that report to show the named failing test now passes after the applied patch. REPORT.md states that tests/test_public_pipeline.py still has 6 passed (those cases never called pipeline.run and were already green) and that tests/test_pipeline_run.py was added; it never names a previously failing test, never shows runner output for that test, and never records a fail-to-pass result after the patch.
